title: Output Mapping Commutes with One Step
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine, let $f$ be a partial symbol map, let $b$ be a choice bit, and let $c$ be a configuration. Taking one step under $b$ in the machine whose transition outputs are mapped by $f$, from the configuration whose output is mapped by $f$, yields the configuration obtained by taking one step in $M$ from $c$ under $b$ and then mapping its output by $f$.
